rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The page recalls that at the standing committee on 14 July, right after the House of Councillors election, 吉田忠智党首 had stated his intention to resign.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: Following discussion at the standing committee on 1 September and its wish that he continue, 吉田忠智党首 withdrew his intention to resign.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: At the press conference after the committee 吉田忠智党首 said he would continue to carry the weight of the office of SDP leader.
